name: Quick Check-In: One Topic
purpose: Thirty focused minutes for one topic that needs your attention now: a decision, a change, a recurring issue, or one area you want to understand more clearly.
method: You name one topic in the intake form. I look at the current astrological influences connected with that area, then we use the time to understand what is active and what perspective the chart may add to the situation you are already living.
bestFor: Established clients with one specific area that needs attention now
A focused question or situation that does not require a full-hour follow-up
A current issue you want to look at in the context of your chart
notFor: Multiple topics or a broader chart review: book Want More Clarity instead
New clients. The Natal Chart Reading comes first
intakeRequirements: Your one topic, written out in the appointment form
includes: One topic examined through the current influences on your chart
A clearer view of the astrological context surrounding that question or situation
preparation: Write your topic out clearly in the intake form: one focused question gives us the most room to go somewhere useful
